Use JavaScript for 95% of use cases. Python in n8n has **NO external libraries** (no requests, pandas, numpy). Use Python only for complex Python-specific logic, standard-library features, or existing Python/team preference; use JavaScript for HTTP requests (`$helpers.httpRequest`), Luxon/date operations, most transformations, or when in doubt.

**Must return** `[{"json": {...}}]`. Python Code nodes use `_input.all()`, `_input.first()`, `_input.item` (Each Item mode), and `_node["Name"]`; webhook data is under `_json["body"]`. Available modules include `json`, `datetime`, `re`, `base64`, `hashlib`, `urllib.parse`, `math`, `random`, `statistics`. No external libraries/imports: `requests`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `psycopg2`, `pymongo`, `beautifulsoup4`, and `selenium` are unavailable. Use HTTP Request/JavaScript, list comprehensions/standard library, database nodes, or HTML Extract node instead.

Prevent ModuleNotFoundError, empty code/missing return, KeyError, IndexError, and incorrect return format. Use `.get()` for dictionaries, check lengths before indexing, handle empty input (`if items:`), and test both All Items and Each Item modes. Always return proper format: `[{"json": {...}}]`. Access webhook data via `["body"]`. Use n8n nodes when libraries are needed.

Examples:
`all_items = _input.all()`
`first_item = _input.first()`
`current_item = _input.item  # Each Item mode only`
`body = _input.first()["json"].get("body", {})`
`return [{"json": {"result": "success"}}]`

Use MCP tools to validate Code node configurations; check node setup with `get_node_essentials`. Read SKILL.md; try DATA_ACCESS.md; study STANDARD_LIBRARY.md, COMMON_PATTERNS.md, and ERROR_PATTERNS.md. Consider using JavaScrip
